typography.headings: Clash Display or Cabinet Grotesk (Expressive, large, modern Grotesk). Use font-light to font-black for tension. DO NOT USE Inter for headings.
typography.body: Manrope or IBM Plex Sans (Clean, highly legible geometric sans)

visual_enhancers.background: Near-black space (#050508) with deep blue/white atmospheric glow using radial gradients. Add subtle CSS noise overlay.
visual_enhancers.particles: Signature golden particle sphere using React Three Fiber. Glitter pouring outward.
visual_enhancers.cursor: Custom framer-motion cursor (small point default, expands on interactive elements to a glowing orb containing 'VIEW' or 'OPEN' text).
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Use sparingly for sticky nav or overlay elements: backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/5 border-b border-white/10.

layouts.hero: Full-screen cinematic entrance. Background fades in, particle sphere appears, headline reveals line-by-line via framer-motion stagger. Minimal top-left wordmark, top-right nav items.
layouts.sections: Continuous journey with no hard cuts. Use large vertical padding (py-32 or py-48) to create massive negative space.
layouts.statement: Large editorial statement section with scroll-driven word-by-word or line-by-line reveals using framer-motion useScroll.
layouts.focus_areas: Large horizontal typography rows (e.g., 01 ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE) spanning full width. Hover triggers expansion, text glow, and subtle image reveal.
layouts.portfolio: Large editorial gallery rows with cursor-following visual reveals (scale 0.7->1, blur-to-sharp).
layouts.team: Editorial numbered list. Hovering over a name reveals a grayscale portrait following the cursor.
layouts.insights: Editorial journal rows with minimal metadata (Date, Category, Title). Hover brightness/tracking animations.

motion.scroll: Lenis for smooth momentum scrolling. Important: setup LenisContext with ReactLenis component.
motion.interactions: Hover tracking expansion (letter-spacing), opacity shifts (50% to 100%), scale transitions.

components_instructions.ParticleSphere: Create a React Three Fiber component with a Canvas. Use points and a custom vertex/fragment shader (or simple useFrame manipulation of position array) to form a sphere. Apply a golden color. On useFrame, rotate the sphere slowly. Use mouse coordinates (state.mouse) to apply gravitational displacement (repulsion/attraction) to the vertices. Emit 'glitter' particles that move outward from the center.
components_instructions.CustomCursor: Fixed framer-motion div that tracks window mouse coordinates. Use a context or global state to determine if hovering over an interactive element to expand the cursor and show text.
components_instructions.EditorialRow: A flex row with border-b border-white/10. Contains a number (01) and large text. On hover, change background slightly or reveal an image using an absolute positioned framer-motion div that follows the local mouse position.
components_instructions.ScrollRevealText: Split text into lines. Use framer-motion whileInView or useScroll to translate Y and fade in each line sequentially.

accessibility.prefers_reduced_motion: Respect prefers-reduced-motion for large transitions. Disable particle system or simplify interactions if enabled.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements (nav links, rows, buttons) MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: 1. Do not use standard centered, generic layouts. Embrace asymmetry and large negative space. 2. Implement a high-end, smooth scrolling experience using 'lenis' package (`<ReactLenis root>`). 3. Ensure deep dark mode aesthetics (#050508) without flat grey sections. 4. Never use 'Inter' for headings. 5. Include data-testid on all interactive elements. 6. Build the signature 3D Golden Particle Sphere in the hero section using @react-three/fiber. 7. Do not use generic Shadcn cards for the main marketing layouts; use custom HTML/Tailwind to allow massive typography and strict lines.
